text:
claire: starting thread — Zephyr promo capacity plan. they expect short spikes ~760 rps for 10-12m, baseline ~260 rps. asking reserved vs burst + autoscale safe defaults.

tom: quick clarifiers — avg tokens? chat vs embeddings mix? strict tail latency?

claire: avg ~175 tokens, ~80% chat. p95 target ~850ms, p50 ~200ms. want cost-efficient 13B quant, fallback allowed.

heidi: rough calc: 760 * 175 = 133k tok/s raw. with caching/batching effective work drops a lot. recommend reserved for baseline 260 rps and burst credits to cover +500 rps peaks.

ram: propose concrete config: reserved 5 GPUs steady, burst pool to support +500 rps for 15m windows, autoscale min_replicas 4 max_replicas 14, fast ramp (30s) and queue depth throttles.

ops-bot: autoscale snippet suggestion to include: {"min_replicas":"4","max_replicas":"14","scale_metric":"rps","target_rps_per_replica":"80","ramp_cooldown_s":"30"}

heidi: routing plan: default to quant13, fallback to fp16 70B if queue_depth > 60 or p95 > 1s for 45s. preheat KV cache 8-10m before promo using synthetic prefix hits.

pricing: Zephyr asked for 12mo reserved quote + burst addon. ballpark reserved reduces unit cost ~20% vs pure burst for quant models. will run exact SKU calc.

sec-bot: security flag — Zephyr requires customer KMS and monthly audit exports. note: Dedicated/Private support customer KMS; Hosted supports envelope encryption + logs export. include Private option for PHI-sensitive flows.

claire: ops runbook bullets to send: - KV preheat 10m before window - burst cap 15m continuous - edge rate limiter return 429 + Retry-After - canary rollout for model changes - fallback route to smaller model on latency threshold.

ram: add monitoring thresholds: p95 > 1s, queue_depth > 100, replica_error_rate > 1% -> trigger paging and fallback. include client retry guidance (exp backoff, max 3).

heidi: sample preheat curl for runbook: for i in $(seq 1 900); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/preheat -d '{"prefix":"zephyr-promo","hits":1}' & done

claire: will schedule 30-min POC preflight with Zephyr ops tomorrow. action items: pricing to deliver 12mo quote, ops to draft runbook, security to prep KMS + audit appendix. I'll draft proposal (reserve 5 GPUs, burst +500 rps, autoscale 4-14, KV preheat, fallback routing) and send EOD.

pricing: noted — will push SKU quote by EOD.

sec-bot: prepping KMS diagram + audit sample now.

ops-bot: created ops doc /ops/poc/zephyr/plan-v1 for eng-ops review.

claire: thanks team. sending proposal draft shortly. :thumbsup:
